description: Server transport chokepoint pin (AGENTS.md — http-client.ts is the single source of truth for all API communication). Every file below performs raw network egress (fetch / EventSource / WebSocket) instead of going through the transport facade at lib/http-client.ts, which re-exports the split transport in apps/lib/ (url, corr-id, interceptors, retry, verbs, streamSSE, authFetch). HAND-MAINTAINED: a generated baseline verifies nothing. Entries may only shrink — a new file doing raw egress must route through the transport, not be added here.
